contentEn.heading: Indications
points: Open and closed wounds

contentEn.heading: In the Primary (All Licence Levels)
points: Expose and examine
Control major hemorrhage with direct pressure, patient positioning, and part positioning (if it does not aggravate other injuries or conditions)
If direct pressure does not control the bleeding, and the wound is in an area amenable to tourniquet application, apply a tourniquet proximal to the wound
If direct pressure does not control the bleeding and the wound is NOT amenable to a tourniquet (i.e. junctional hemorrhage), consider wound packing. Do NOT pack wounds on the neck, chest, or abdomen
Bandage the bleed once hemorrhage has been controlled

contentEn.heading: Protocol and Treatment Components
points: Protocol component: provide analgesia when / if appropriate based on patient presentation
Treatment component: clean and dress minor wounds, then bandage them
Apply cold, if required
Assess distal circulation
Bandage major wounds (if not already done)

contentEn.heading: Hemorrhage Control - Order of Preference
points: 1. Direct pressure
2. Pressure dressing
3. Positioning the part (elevation of the injured part, only if it will not aggravate other injuries or conditions)
4. Positioning the patient (at rest and supine if other injuries and conditions permit)
5. Tourniquet (note the time and do not release once applied)
6. Extremity wound packing if the bleed cannot be controlled

contentEn.heading: Key Notes
points: Absence of distal circulation may indicate a limb-threatening injury or condition

If the limb is pulseless distal to an injury, one attempt can be made to re-align the limb to the anatomical position. If circulation returns the patient can be treated as stable; if the limb remains pulseless the patient should be managed as unstable

Cold may be applied if the distal circulation is not impaired; it may be applied earlier (at the end of the primary survey) provided circulation in the injured limb has been checked and compared with the uninjured limb
Embedded objects should be stabilized in place, unless impairing the airway
Immobilize limbs if there are large wounds or wounds over joints

contentZh.heading: 适应症
points: 开放性和闭合性伤口

contentZh.heading: Primary 阶段（所有执照级别）
points: 暴露并检查伤口
用直接压迫（direct pressure）、摆放患者体位和伤肢体位来控制大出血（前提是不加重其他损伤或病情）
如果直接压迫无法止血，且伤口位于可以使用 tourniquet（止血带）的部位，在伤口近端加用 tourniquet
如果直接压迫无法止血，而伤口不适合使用 tourniquet（例如 junctional hemorrhage 交界部位出血），考虑伤口填塞（wound packing）。注意：颈部、胸部、腹部的伤口禁止填塞
出血控制后再对伤口进行包扎

contentZh.heading: Protocol 与 Treatment 阶段
points: Protocol 阶段：根据患者表现，在适当时机给予镇痛（analgesia）
Treatment 阶段：清洁并敷料覆盖小伤口，然后包扎
必要时冷敷
评估远端循环（distal circulation）
包扎大伤口（如尚未包扎）

contentZh.heading: 止血方法的优先顺序
points: 1. 直接压迫（direct pressure）
2. 加压敷料（pressure dressing）
3. 摆放伤肢体位（抬高患肢，仅在不加重其他损伤时进行）
4. 摆放患者体位（休息、仰卧，前提是其他损伤允许）
5. Tourniquet（记录使用时间，一旦上紧绝不放松）
6. 四肢伤口无法止血时进行伤口填塞（wound packing）

contentZh.heading: 关键要点
points: 远端循环消失可能提示肢体面临威胁（limb-threatening）
如果损伤远端的肢体无脉搏，可以尝试一次将肢体复位到解剖位置。若循环恢复，患者可按稳定（stable）处理；若仍无脉搏，患者应按不稳定（unstable）处理
远端循环未受影响时才可以冷敷；如果已对比检查过伤肢与健肢的循环，可以更早（primary survey 结束时）冷敷
嵌入伤口的异物应原位固定，除非它妨碍气道
伤口较大或伤口跨越关节时，应固定该肢体

examTipsEn: Tourniquet: always note the time of application and NEVER release it once applied.
Never pack wounds on the neck, chest, or abdomen.
Pulseless limb: only ONE realignment attempt is allowed - circulation returns = stable, still pulseless = unstable (Rapid Transport).
examTipsZh: Tourniquet 必须记录使用时间，一旦上紧绝不放松。
颈部、胸部、腹部的伤口绝对禁止填塞（wound packing）。
无脉搏肢体只允许复位一次：循环恢复=stable，仍无脉搏=unstable（需 Rapid Transport）。

contentEn.heading: Overview
points: When a part of the body is completely avulsed (torn off) or amputated (cut off), preserve the amputated part in optimal condition to maximize the chances of successful reattachment
Turn your attention to the amputated part only once the patient's injuries have been stabilized

contentEn.heading: Procedure
points: 1. Rinse the amputated part with cool sterile water to remove any gross contaminants/debris
2. Wrap the part loosely in saline-moistened sterile gauze
3. Place the amputated part inside a plastic bag and keep it cool in a protective container
4. Transport with the patient

contentEn.heading: Key Points
points: Do not warm the amputated part
Never place the part in water
Never place the part directly on ice
Never use dry ice to cool the part

contentZh.heading: 概述
points: 当身体某部分被完全撕脱（avulsed）或离断（amputated）时，应尽量将离断部分保存在最佳状态，以最大化再植（reattachment）成功的机会
先稳定患者本身的伤情，之后再处理离断的肢体

contentZh.heading: 操作步骤
points: 1. 用凉的无菌水（cool sterile water）冲洗离断部分，去除明显的污染物和碎屑
2. 用生理盐水浸湿的无菌纱布（saline-moistened sterile gauze）松松地包裹
3. 放入塑料袋中，再放进保护性容器内保持低温
4. 与患者一同转运

contentZh.heading: 关键要点
points: 不要给离断部分加温
绝不能把离断部分直接泡在水里
绝不能把离断部分直接放在冰上
绝不能使用干冰（dry ice）降温

examTipsEn: Remember the four NEVERs: no warming, no water immersion, no direct ice contact, no dry ice.
The correct sequence is rinse (cool sterile water) - wrap (moist sterile gauze) - bag - keep cool - transport with patient.
examTipsZh: 记住四个「绝不」：不加温、不泡水、不直接接触冰、不用干冰。
正确顺序：凉无菌水冲洗 → 湿盐水纱布松裹 → 装袋 → 保冷 → 随患者转运。

contentEn.heading: Indications
points: Suspected fractures
Suspected dislocations
Suspected severe sprains

contentEn.heading: In the Primary (All Licence Levels)
points: Expose and examine
Control major hemorrhage
Stabilize fractured limb(s), pelvis or hip
Check distal pulse(s) and reassess throughout the call
Realign grossly deformed or pulseless limb(s)
Bind pelvis if appropriate
Apply cold

contentEn.heading: In the Protocol Component
points: Provide analgesia prior to movement, in stable, appropriate patients

contentEn.heading: In the Treatment Component
points: Apply traction if appropriate
Immobilize the joints above and below the injury site
Reapply cold if appropriate
Elevate if appropriate

contentZh.heading: 适应症
points: 疑似骨折（fracture）
疑似脱位（dislocation）
疑似严重扭伤（severe sprain）

contentZh.heading: Primary 阶段（所有执照级别）
points: 暴露并检查
控制大出血
稳定骨折的肢体、骨盆或髋部
检查远端脉搏，并在整个呼叫过程中反复评估
复位严重变形或无脉搏的肢体
必要时绑扎骨盆（pelvic binding）
冷敷

contentZh.heading: Protocol 阶段
points: 对稳定且合适的患者，在移动之前先给予镇痛（analgesia prior to movement）

contentZh.heading: Treatment 阶段
points: 适当时使用牵引（traction）
固定损伤部位上方和下方的关节
适当时再次冷敷
适当时抬高患肢

examTipsEn: Analgesia comes BEFORE movement in stable patients - giving Entonox only after realignment/fracture management is a 100% deduction per Appendix A.
Always immobilize the joint ABOVE and the joint BELOW the injury site.
Distal pulses must be checked and reassessed throughout the call, especially after any realignment or splinting.
examTipsZh: 稳定患者必须在移动之前给镇痛——按 Appendix A，复位/骨折处理之后才给 Entonox 会被直接扣 100%。
必须同时固定损伤部位上方和下方的两个关节。
远端脉搏要贯穿全程反复评估，尤其是复位或夹板固定之后。

contentEn.heading: Classification and Transport Category
points: A patient with a hip dislocation is considered to have a limb-threatening injury if there is neuro or vascular impairment
ALL hip dislocations are in the Rapid Transport Category
Isolated hip fractures are rapid transport only if there is neuro or vascular impairment

contentEn.heading: Interventions For All Licence Levels
points: Quickly support the injured limb using helpers, rolled blankets, and ties
Move the patient onto a firm, blanketed stretcher or spinal device; secure the patient to eliminate motion in the affected hip
Early medical reduction of the dislocation is essential to avoid serious long-term complications
Conduct any remainder of the secondary survey en route to hospital
Maintain a regular check of vital signs, the patient's general condition, and the state of distal pulses and neurological function in the affected limb
If a dislocation is suspected and the hip spontaneously reduces during treatment or transportation, update the receiving hospital
Pain management

contentZh.heading: 分类与转运级别
points: 髋关节脱位如果伴有神经或血管功能受损（neuro or vascular impairment），视为肢体威胁性损伤（limb-threatening injury）
所有髋关节脱位都属于 Rapid Transport Category（快速转运级别）
单纯髋部骨折只有在伴神经或血管受损时才需要快速转运

contentZh.heading: 所有执照级别的处置
points: 迅速用助手、卷起的毯子和绑带支撑受伤的肢体
将患者移到铺有毯子的硬质担架或脊柱固定装置上，固定患者以消除患髋的活动
尽早由医院进行复位（early medical reduction）对于避免严重的长期并发症至关重要
其余的 secondary survey 在送医途中完成
定期检查生命体征、患者总体状况，以及患肢的远端脉搏和神经功能
如果怀疑脱位的髋关节在治疗或转运过程中自行复位（spontaneously reduces），要向接收医院通报
疼痛管理（pain management）

examTipsEn: ALL hip dislocations = Rapid Transport Category; isolated hip fractures are rapid transport only with neuro/vascular impairment.
Do the remainder of the secondary survey EN ROUTE - do not delay transport on scene.
If the hip spontaneously reduces, you must notify the receiving hospital.
examTipsZh: 所有髋脱位一律 Rapid Transport；单纯髋部骨折只有伴神经/血管受损才快速转运。
剩余的 secondary survey 在途中做，不要在现场耽误转运。
髋关节若自行复位，必须通报接收医院。

contentEn.heading: Indications
points: Suspected mid-shaft femur fractures in stable patients

contentEn.heading: Procedure (Before Splint)
points: 1. Assess distal circulation, sensation, and function
2. Apply cold if appropriate - ice on for 10 minutes, off for 5
3. Give analgesia if not contraindicated
4. Ensure the patient is supine with the injured leg in line with the body
5. Maintain manual stabilization after movement and reassess distal pulse

contentEn.heading: STAPLES Mnemonic (Sager Splint)
points: Size: place the splint beside the injured leg
Thigh: secure the thigh strap/bandage
Ankle: apply the ankle harness above the malleoli
Padding: ensure adequate padding
Lbs.: apply traction (once applied, do NOT release). Closed mid-shaft fractures: 10% of the patient's body weight to a maximum of 15 lbs (7 kg). Open mid-shaft fractures: maximum 5 lbs
Elevate: elevate the bottom of the Sager to align it neutral with the leg (a shoe under the wheel works well)
Straps: stabilize the limb to the splint with three elasticized straps; place a blanket between the legs and strap the legs together

contentEn.heading: Ongoing Care
points: With each movement/reassessment of ABCs or vitals, traction should be reassessed and corrected if necessary

contentZh.heading: 适应症
points: 稳定患者的疑似股骨中段骨折（mid-shaft femur fracture）

contentZh.heading: 上夹板前的步骤
points: 1. 评估远端循环、感觉和运动功能（circulation, sensation, function）
2. 适当时冷敷——冰敷 10 分钟、停 5 分钟
3. 如无禁忌，给予镇痛（analgesia）
4. 确保患者仰卧，伤腿与身体成一直线
5. 移动后保持手法固定（manual stabilization），并再次评估远端脉搏

contentZh.heading: STAPLES 口诀（Sager 夹板）
points: Size：把夹板放在伤腿旁边比量长度
Thigh：固定大腿带
Ankle：在踝部内外踝（malleoli）上方套上踝部固定带
Padding：确保衬垫充分
Lbs.：施加牵引（一旦施加绝不放松）。闭合性中段骨折：体重的 10%，最多 15 lbs（7 kg）；开放性中段骨折：最多 5 lbs
Elevate：抬高 Sager 底部使其与腿保持中立位对线（轮子下垫只鞋效果很好）
Straps：用三条弹性绑带把患肢固定在夹板上；两腿之间垫毯子并把双腿绑在一起

contentZh.heading: 后续处理
points: 每次移动患者或重新评估 ABC/生命体征时，都要重新检查牵引并在必要时校正

examTipsEn: Traction weights: closed = 10% body weight, max 15 lbs (7 kg); open = max 5 lbs. Never release traction once applied.
Only for MID-SHAFT femur fractures in STABLE patients.
Recheck traction and distal pulses after every move.
examTipsZh: 牵引重量：闭合性=体重 10%、上限 15 lbs（7 kg）；开放性=最多 5 lbs。牵引一旦施加绝不放松。
只适用于稳定患者的股骨中段骨折。
每次移动后都要复查牵引和远端脉搏。

contentEn.heading: Indications
points: Major mechanism suggestive of pelvic fracture with ANY of the following:
Hemodynamic instability (heart rate > 100 or systolic blood pressure < 90 mmHg)
Pelvic pain on exam
Pelvic instability
Decreased level of consciousness
Major injury distracting from pelvic exam

contentEn.heading: Contraindications
points: Neck-of-femur ("hip") fractures
Falls from standing height or other simple falls

contentEn.heading: Technique
points: Bind the pelvis with a commercial grade binder or three overlapping broad triangular bandages; zap straps are NOT an acceptable form of binding
Align the centre of the belt with the greater trochanter
Tie the bandages tightly enough to support the pelvis but not cause pain
Do not roll the patient when applying the bandages
The pelvis should be stabilized prior to transport
Use a commercial pelvic binder if available - it offers ease/speed of application and is effective at compressing the intra-pelvic space

contentEn.heading: Rationale
points: Binding reduces overall pelvic volume and creates a tamponade effect
Stabilizes fracture fragments, reducing hemorrhage from the fracture sites
Improves patient comfort

contentZh.heading: 适应症
points: 提示骨盆骨折的重大受伤机制（major mechanism），并伴有以下任一项：
血流动力学不稳定（心率 > 100 或收缩压 < 90 mmHg）
查体时骨盆疼痛
骨盆不稳定
意识水平下降
存在干扰骨盆检查的其他严重损伤（distracting injury）

contentZh.heading: 禁忌症
points: 股骨颈（neck-of-femur，即「hip」髋部）骨折
站立高度跌倒或其他简单跌倒

contentZh.heading: 操作方法
points: 使用商用骨盆绑带（commercial binder）或三条相互重叠的宽三角巾绑扎骨盆；zap straps（塑料扎带）不是可接受的绑扎方式
绑带中心对准股骨大转子（greater trochanter）
绑扎的松紧度以能支撑骨盆但不引起疼痛为准
绑扎时不要翻滚（roll）患者
核心原则：骨盆必须在转运前完成稳定
有商用骨盆绑带时优先使用——上得快、操作简单，且能有效压缩骨盆内腔

contentZh.heading: 原理
points: 绑扎减少骨盆总容积并产生压塞效应（tamponade effect）
稳定骨折断端，减少骨折面出血
改善患者舒适度

examTipsEn: Centre of the binder goes over the GREATER TROCHANTER, not the iliac crests.
Contraindicated for hip (neck-of-femur) fractures and simple falls from standing height.
Do not log-roll the patient to apply the binder, and zap straps are never acceptable.
examTipsZh: 绑带中心对准的是 greater trochanter（股骨大转子），不是髂嵴。
髋部（股骨颈）骨折和站立高度的简单跌倒是禁忌症。
上绑带时不能翻滚患者；zap straps 永远不可接受。

contentEn.heading: Indications
points: Follow the NEXUS Criteria and the Canadian C-Spine Guidelines

contentEn.heading: Interventions For All Licence Levels
points: Confirm clinical indication(s) for spinal motion restriction
Patient meets the NEXUS or Canadian C-Spine indications
Manually stabilize the head and neck
Apply hard collar
Place patient on a spinal immobilization device
Place foam rollers / foam blocks
Secure the patient's body to the spinal immobilization device if appropriate (do not tape the head)

contentZh.heading: 适应症
points: 遵循 NEXUS Criteria 和 Canadian C-Spine Guidelines 判断是否需要脊柱固定

contentZh.heading: 所有执照级别的处置
points: 确认存在脊柱活动限制（spinal motion restriction）的临床指征
患者符合 NEXUS 或 Canadian C-Spine 的指征
手法固定头颈部（manual stabilization）
上硬质颈托（hard collar）
将患者放到脊柱固定装置（spinal immobilization device）上
放置泡沫滚轴/泡沫块（foam rollers/blocks）固定头部两侧
适当时将患者身体固定到脊柱固定装置上（不要用胶带固定头部 do not tape the head）

examTipsEn: Sequence matters: manual stabilization first, then hard collar, then device, then foam blocks, then body straps.
Do NOT tape the head when securing the patient.
Decision to immobilize is based on NEXUS / Canadian C-Spine criteria, not on mechanism alone.
examTipsZh: 顺序很重要：先手法固定 → 硬颈托 → 脊柱固定装置 → 泡沫块 → 绑身体。
固定时不要用胶带缠头（do not tape the head）。
是否固定由 NEXUS / Canadian C-Spine 标准决定，不是只看受伤机制。

contentEn.heading: Indications and Classification
points: Any patient with head trauma and any altered level of consciousness should be suspected of having a traumatic brain injury (TBI)
GCS >= 13: mild injury
GCS 9-12: moderate injury
GCS <= 8: severe traumatic brain injury

contentEn.heading: Interventions For All Licence Levels
points: Ensure adequate oxygenation (SpO2 >= 94%)
If the patient is having difficulty maintaining respirations, assist with ventilations keeping the SpO2 at >= 94%
Elevate head of the bed to 30 degrees
Loosen hard collar

contentEn.heading: Additional Primary Care Paramedic Interventions
points: Maintain normal blood sugar levels (4.0-8.0 mmol/L)
Maintain a blood pressure of > 120 mmHg systolic
IV - TKVO if systolic BP is > 120 mmHg
TXA is contraindicated for isolated TBIs

contentZh.heading: 适应症与分级
points: 任何头部外伤伴任何程度意识改变的患者，都应怀疑创伤性脑损伤（TBI）
GCS ≥ 13：轻度损伤
GCS 9-12：中度损伤
GCS ≤ 8：重度创伤性脑损伤

contentZh.heading: 所有执照级别的处置
points: 确保充分氧合（SpO2 ≥ 94%）
如果患者维持呼吸困难，辅助通气并把 SpO2 维持在 ≥ 94%
床头抬高 30 度
松开硬质颈托（loosen hard collar）

contentZh.heading: PCP 附加处置
points: 维持正常血糖水平（4.0-8.0 mmol/L）
维持收缩压 > 120 mmHg
收缩压 > 120 mmHg 时开 IV，速度 TKVO（保持静脉通路开放）
单纯 TBI 禁用 TXA（tranexamic acid）

examTipsEn: Memorize the GCS cutoffs: >=13 mild, 9-12 moderate, <=8 severe.
TXA is CONTRAINDICATED in isolated TBI.
Head of bed 30 degrees + loosen the hard collar - both reduce intracranial pressure.
examTipsZh: 背熟 GCS 分级：≥13 轻度、9-12 中度、≤8 重度。
单纯 TBI 禁用 TXA——这是常考禁忌。
床头抬高 30 度并松开硬颈托，两者都是为了降低颅内压。

contentEn.heading: In the Primary Survey (All Licence Levels)
points: Expose and examine
Initiate cooling for 15-20 minutes
Apply high flow oxygen if suspected inhalation injury or SOB
Calculate BSA (Rule of Nines)

contentEn.heading: Protocol and Treatment Components
points: Protocol component: consider pain management, if indicated
Treatment component: once cooling has finished, dress the wound with sterile, nonstick, dry gauze

contentEn.heading: Additional Primary Care Paramedic Interventions
points: Initiate IV if indicated
Hypotensive: fluid 20 ml/kg to a maximum of 2 litres

contentEn.heading: Cooling Notes
points: Patients should receive 15-20 minutes of cooling in the immediate aftermath of the burn, inclusive of any time bystanders have provided effective cooling
Cooling is also an important analgesic strategy
Burns should be cooled with cool (not cold) running water wherever possible - this may involve remaining on scene for over 20 minutes in patients without immediate life-threatening burns or injury
In patients requiring immediate conveyance, the use of cool saline may be sufficient

contentZh.heading: Primary Survey（所有执照级别）
points: 暴露并检查
开始降温冷却 15-20 分钟
疑似吸入性损伤（inhalation injury）或呼吸困难时给高流量氧
用 Rule of Nines（九分法）计算烧伤面积 BSA

contentZh.heading: Protocol 与 Treatment 阶段
points: Protocol 阶段：有指征时考虑疼痛管理
Treatment 阶段：冷却完成后，用无菌、不粘、干燥的纱布（sterile, nonstick, dry gauze）覆盖创面

contentZh.heading: PCP 附加处置
points: 有指征时建立 IV
低血压时：补液 20 ml/kg，最多 2 升

contentZh.heading: 冷却要点
points: 烧伤后应立即冷却 15-20 分钟，这包括旁观者已进行的有效冷却时间
冷却本身也是重要的镇痛手段
尽可能用凉的（cool，不是冰冷 cold）流动水冷却；对于没有立即生命威胁的患者，可以为此在现场停留超过 20 分钟
需要立即转运的患者，用凉的生理盐水（cool saline）冷却即可

examTipsEn: Cooling: 15-20 minutes with cool (NOT cold) running water, including bystander cooling time.
After cooling, dress with sterile, nonstick, DRY gauze - not wet dressings.
PCP fluid for hypotension: 20 ml/kg to a max of 2 L.
examTipsZh: 冷却 15-20 分钟，用凉水（cool）而不是冰水（cold），旁观者已冷却的时间要算进去。
冷却结束后用无菌、不粘、干燥的纱布覆盖——不是湿敷料。
PCP 低血压补液：20 ml/kg，上限 2 L。

contentEn.heading: Indications
points: Suspected hypothermia because of mechanism of injury, history, or presentation of the patient

contentEn.heading: Interventions For All Licence Levels
points: Assess and maintain the ABCs as necessary
Take up to 30-45 seconds to determine pulselessness in the severely hypothermic patient
Remove wet and cold clothing and cover with blankets or dry clothing
Take temperature if appropriate

In cardiac arrest: apply AED and analyze, defibrillate up to three times if indicated, then continue CPR and rapid transport to hospital (after three defibrillations, do not pause CPR for analyzing or shocks)

contentEn.heading: Mild (>32 to <35 C) and Moderate (>28 to <32 C) - Actively Rewarm
points: Mild activity (if appropriate)
Preheat the interior of the ambulance to 30 C
Use hot packs wrapped in towels
Warm blankets

contentEn.heading: Severe (<28 C) - Do NOT Actively Rewarm
points: Insulate the patient to prevent further heat loss
Heat the ambulance to 30 C
Avoid rough handling

contentZh.heading: 适应症
points: 根据受伤机制、病史或患者表现怀疑低体温症（hypothermia）

contentZh.heading: 所有执照级别的处置
points: 评估并维持 ABC
对严重低体温患者，判断无脉搏（pulselessness）可以用最长 30-45 秒
脱掉湿冷衣物，用毯子或干燥衣物覆盖
适当时测量体温
心脏骤停时：贴 AED 分析，有指征时最多除颤三次，之后继续 CPR 并快速送医（三次除颤后不再为分析或电击而暂停 CPR）

contentZh.heading: 轻度（>32 至 <35 C）和中度（>28 至 <32 C）——主动复温
points: 适当时让患者轻度活动
把救护车车厢预热到 30 C
使用毛巾包裹的热敷袋（hot packs）
加盖温暖的毯子

contentZh.heading: 重度（<28 C）——禁止主动复温
points: 给患者做好保温隔热，防止进一步失温
救护车加热到 30 C
避免粗暴搬动（avoid rough handling）

examTipsEn: Severe hypothermia (<28 C): NO active rewarming, insulate only, and handle gently - rough handling can trigger arrest.
Arrest in hypothermia: maximum 3 defibrillations, then continuous CPR with no pauses for analysis, and rapid transport.
Pulse check may take 30-45 seconds in the severely hypothermic patient (vs 10 seconds normally).
examTipsZh: 重度低体温（<28 C）禁止主动复温，只做隔热保温，并且必须轻柔搬动——粗暴搬动可诱发心脏骤停。
低体温心脏骤停：最多除颤 3 次，之后不间断 CPR（不再暂停分析/电击），快速转运。
重度低体温患者判断脉搏可用 30-45 秒（正常情况只有 10 秒）。

contentEn.heading: Indications
points: Any neurological deficits
Altered LOC or unconscious
Difficulty maintaining airway
Shortness of breath, noisy or absent respirations
Weak, rapid or absent radial pulse

contentEn.heading: Interventions For All Licence Levels
points: Assess and manage ABCs as required
Provide supplemental oxygen to maintain SpO2 >= 94%
Position the patient
Blood glucose check
Accurate recognition (FAST-VAN)
Timely transport; notify the receiving facility while en route

contentEn.heading: Additional Primary Care Paramedic Interventions
points: (En route) Obtain vascular access: select a site above the level of the wrist using a size 18 G, preferably on the right side

contentZh.heading: 适应症
points: 任何神经功能缺损（neurological deficits）
意识改变（altered LOC）或昏迷
维持气道困难
呼吸困难、呼吸音异常或呼吸消失
桡动脉搏动弱、快或消失

contentZh.heading: 所有执照级别的处置
points: 按需要评估并管理 ABC
补充氧气使 SpO2 ≥ 94%
摆放患者体位
检测血糖（blood glucose check）
用 FAST-VAN 工具准确识别卒中
及时转运，途中通知接收医院（notify while en route）

contentZh.heading: PCP 附加处置
points: （途中）建立血管通路：选择腕部以上的部位，使用 18 G 留置针，首选右侧

examTipsEn: Blood glucose check is mandatory - hypoglycemia is the classic stroke mimic.
Recognition tool is FAST-VAN; notify the receiving facility while en route.
PCP IV for stroke: 18 G, above the wrist, preferably on the RIGHT side, started en route.
examTipsZh: 血糖检测是必做项——低血糖是最经典的卒中模拟表现（stroke mimic）。
识别工具是 FAST-VAN；必须在途中通知接收医院。
PCP 卒中 IV 要求：18 G、腕部以上、首选右侧、途中建立。

contentEn.heading: Interventions For All Licence Levels
points: Control external hemorrhage
Limit patient movement to reduce clot disruption
Protect against heat loss
Cover extruded bowel or eviscerated abdominal contents with moist, sterile dressings followed by an occlusive layer
Do not place contents back in the abdominal cavity
Position of comfort
Transport

contentEn.heading: Additional Primary Care Paramedic Interventions (En Route)
points: Obtain vascular access and correct hypoperfusion
TXA, if indicated

contentZh.heading: 所有执照级别的处置
points: 控制外出血
限制患者活动，减少血凝块被破坏（clot disruption）
防止热量流失
对脱出的肠管或腹腔内容物（eviscerated contents），先用湿润的无菌敷料覆盖，再加一层封闭性敷料（occlusive layer）
绝不把脱出的内容物塞回腹腔
舒适体位（position of comfort）
转运

contentZh.heading: PCP 附加处置（途中）
points: 建立血管通路并纠正低灌注（hypoperfusion）
有指征时给 TXA

examTipsEn: Evisceration: moist sterile dressing FIRST, then occlusive layer on top - and never push contents back in.
Limit movement specifically to avoid disrupting clots.
PCP interventions (IV, TXA) are done EN ROUTE, not on scene.
examTipsZh: 肠管脱出：先湿无菌敷料、再盖封闭层——顺序不能反，且绝不塞回腹腔。
限制患者活动的目的就是防止血凝块被破坏。
PCP 的 IV 和 TXA 都在途中做，不在现场耽误时间。

treatments.titleZh: 充血性心力衰竭/肺水肿

contentEn.heading: Indications
points: Drowning
Congestive heart failure
Cardiogenic shock
Exposure to toxins

contentEn.heading: Interventions For All Licence Levels
points: Keep the patient at rest and avoid exertion during transfers; bring equipment to the patient, including lifting and transfer devices
Position the patient sitting upright with legs hung down
Keep the patient warm and protect from further heat loss
Provide supplemental oxygen to keep SpO2 >= 94%
Assist ventilations if altered LOC or SpO2 < 94%
Transport

contentEn.heading: Additional Primary Care Paramedic Interventions (On Scene)
points: Consider continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP)
If positive pressure ventilation by bag-valve mask is required, consider use of a PEEP valve (5 cmH2O to start)

contentZh.heading: 适应症
points: 溺水（drowning）
充血性心力衰竭（CHF）
心源性休克（cardiogenic shock）
毒物暴露

contentZh.heading: 所有执照级别的处置
points: 让患者保持静息，转移时避免用力；把设备（包括搬运和转移装置）带到患者身边
让患者取坐直位、双腿下垂（sitting upright with legs hung down）
保暖并防止进一步热量流失
补充氧气使 SpO2 ≥ 94%
如意识改变或 SpO2 < 94%，辅助通气
转运

contentZh.heading: PCP 附加处置（现场）
points: 考虑使用 CPAP（持续气道正压）
如需 BVM 正压通气，考虑加 PEEP 阀（从 5 cmH2O 开始）

examTipsEn: Position is key: sitting upright with legs dangling down - never lay a CHF patient flat.
Bring the equipment TO the patient; any exertion can worsen pulmonary edema.
PCP: CPAP is considered ON SCENE for CHF; PEEP valve starts at 5 cmH2O.
examTipsZh: 体位是关键：坐直、双腿下垂——CHF 患者绝不能平躺。
设备搬到患者身边，任何体力消耗都会加重肺水肿。
PCP 的 CPAP 在现场就要考虑；PEEP 阀从 5 cmH2O 起始。

contentEn.heading: Interventions For All Licence Levels
points: Control any bleeding with gauze
Assist oxygenation and ventilation if necessary
Seal open chest wounds with a three-sided occlusive dressing or commercial chest seal (monitor closely for development of tension pneumothorax; relieve if necessary)
MANUALLY stabilize flail chest
Position the patient ASAP

contentEn.heading: Additional Primary Care Paramedic Interventions (En Route)
points: Vascular access if required
TXA if indicated

contentZh.heading: 所有执照级别的处置
points: 用纱布控制出血
必要时辅助氧合与通气
开放性胸部伤口用三面封闭敷料（three-sided occlusive dressing）或商用胸部密封贴（chest seal）封闭；密切监测是否发展为张力性气胸（tension pneumothorax），必要时解除封闭减压
用手法（MANUALLY）稳定连枷胸（flail chest）
尽快摆好患者体位

contentZh.heading: PCP 附加处置（途中）
points: 需要时建立血管通路
有指征时给 TXA

examTipsEn: Open chest wound = three-sided occlusive dressing or commercial chest seal, then watch for tension pneumothorax and burp/relieve the seal if it develops.
Flail chest is stabilized MANUALLY - not with sandbags or tape.
PCP adjuncts (IV, TXA) happen en route.
examTipsZh: 开放性胸部伤口用三面封闭敷料或商用 chest seal；封闭后要盯紧张力性气胸，一旦出现要解除封闭减压。
连枷胸用手法稳定——不是沙袋也不是胶带。
PCP 的 IV 和 TXA 在途中完成。

contentEn.heading: Scene Safety
points: Paramedic safety is critical: do NOT approach electrical sources or downed power lines until qualified personnel have deemed the scene safe

contentEn.heading: Interventions For All Licence Levels
points: Consider spinal motion restriction
If in cardiac arrest: begin compressions and follow appropriate guidelines for resuscitation
Supplemental oxygen as required
Flush and decontaminate the affected areas with sterile saline
Do not cool burns longer than 15-20 minutes, including decontamination time
Dress injuries as required
Identify type of current and duration of contact
Estimate total surface area using Burn Estimation Charts
Initiate conveyance; consider intercept with additional resources
Consider using the ambulance heater during conveyance if significant body surface area cooling is required
If there is no inhalation injury, consider analgesia to effect

contentEn.heading: Additional Primary Care Paramedic Interventions
points: Obtain vascular access
If hypotensive: consider other causes of shock
Fluid bolus: 20 ml/kg to a maximum of 2 litres, reassessing every 500 ml

contentZh.heading: 现场安全
points: 急救员安全第一：在有资质的人员确认现场安全之前，绝不接近电源或倒落的电线（downed power lines）

contentZh.heading: 所有执照级别的处置
points: 考虑脊柱活动限制（spinal motion restriction）
如果发生心脏骤停：开始胸外按压，按相应复苏指南处理
按需补充氧气
用无菌生理盐水冲洗并去污染受累区域
烧伤冷却总时长不超过 15-20 分钟（含去污时间）
按需要包扎伤口
确认电流类型（type of current）和接触时长
用 Burn Estimation Charts（烧伤面积估算图）估算总受累面积
启动转运；考虑与其他资源途中会合（intercept）
如果大面积体表被冷却过，转运途中考虑开启车内暖气
如无吸入性损伤，可考虑镇痛并滴定至有效（analgesia to effect）

contentZh.heading: PCP 附加处置
points: 建立血管通路
如果低血压：要考虑其他休克原因
补液 bolus：20 ml/kg，最多 2 升，每输 500 ml 重新评估一次

examTipsEn: Scene safety first - never approach until qualified personnel declare the scene safe.
Cooling (including decontamination time) must not exceed 15-20 minutes.
Hypotension after electrical contact: PCP must consider OTHER causes of shock, not just the burn.
examTipsZh: 现场安全永远第一——有资质人员宣布安全之前绝不接近。
冷却时间（含去污时间）不得超过 15-20 分钟。
电击伤后低血压：PCP 必须考虑其他休克原因，不能只归因于烧伤。

contentEn.heading: Interventions For All Licence Levels
points: Move the patient to a cool area if appropriate
Remove all clothing on the patient
If available, begin convective cooling with air conditioning set to maximum cold, in conjunction with any other interventions
Apply cold, wet towels to the head, torso, and thighs to promote evaporative cooling; immerse feet and legs in a bucket or basin of ice water
Continue cooling efforts for a minimum of 10 minutes prior to beginning conveyance to hospital
Initial vital signs must include a blood glucose measurement if there is decreased LOC
The most aggressive cooling method available should be applied during transport and continued until the recommended treatment endpoints are reached
Continue evaporative cooling with soaked towels (head, torso and thighs)
Begin or continue convective cooling with the ambulance AC on maximum cold

contentEn.heading: Additional Primary Care Paramedic Interventions
points: Consider the need for fluid replacement in patients with signs and symptoms of dehydration

contentZh.heading: 所有执照级别的处置
points: 适当时把患者移到凉爽的区域
脱去患者的全部衣物
有条件时开启空调至最大制冷，进行对流降温（convective cooling），与其他措施同时进行
把冷湿毛巾敷在头部、躯干和大腿促进蒸发降温（evaporative cooling）；把双脚和小腿浸入装冰水的桶或盆中
开始转运医院之前，降温至少要持续 10 分钟
如患者意识下降，首套生命体征必须包含血糖测量
转运途中应采用现有条件下最激进的降温方式，并持续到达到推荐的治疗终点
持续用湿透的毛巾（头、躯干、大腿）做蒸发降温
救护车空调开最大冷风，开始或继续对流降温

contentZh.heading: PCP 附加处置
points: 对有脱水症状和体征的患者，考虑是否需要补液（fluid replacement）

examTipsEn: Cool FIRST, transport SECOND: a minimum of 10 minutes of cooling before beginning conveyance.
Remove ALL clothing and cool aggressively - wet towels on head/torso/thighs plus ice-water immersion of feet and legs.
Decreased LOC = blood glucose must be part of the initial vitals.
examTipsZh: 先降温、后转运：出发前至少持续降温 10 分钟。
脱光全部衣物并激进降温——头/躯干/大腿冷湿毛巾 + 双脚小腿浸冰水。
意识下降时，首套生命体征必须含血糖。

contentEn.heading: Interventions For All Licence Levels
points: Apply spinal motion restriction as indicated based on the mechanism of injury
Keep the patient at rest
Position the patient sitting up
Remove wet clothing and dry the patient
Avoid rough handling
Maintain body temperature
Perform basic airway management and initiate intermittent positive pressure ventilations (IPPV) if required to support failing respirations
If the patient is in cardiac or respiratory arrest, immediately commence resuscitation according to the appropriate guideline

contentEn.heading: Additional Primary Care Paramedic Interventions
points: Use PEEP or CPAP if indicated

contentZh.heading: 所有执照级别的处置
points: 根据受伤机制判断是否需要脊柱活动限制（SMR）
让患者保持静息
让患者取坐位（sitting up）
脱去湿衣物并擦干患者
避免粗暴搬动
维持体温
进行基础气道管理；如需支持衰竭的呼吸，启动间歇正压通气（IPPV）
如患者心脏或呼吸骤停，立即按相应指南开始复苏

contentZh.heading: PCP 附加处置
points: 有指征时使用 PEEP 或 CPAP

examTipsEn: Drowning patients sit UP, get dried and kept warm, and are handled gently (hypothermia often coexists).
SMR only as indicated by mechanism - not automatic for every drowning.
Failing respirations = start IPPV; arrest = resuscitate per the appropriate guideline (asphyxial arrest rules apply).
examTipsZh: 溺水患者坐位、擦干、保暖、轻柔搬动（常合并低体温）。
SMR 只在受伤机制提示时才用——不是每个溺水都自动上颈托。
呼吸衰竭就上 IPPV；骤停就按相应指南复苏（适用窒息性骤停规则）。

treatments.titleEn: IV Procedures, Maintenance and Rate Calculation
treatments.titleZh: 静脉输液操作、维护与滴速计算

contentEn.heading: Indications
points: Replace fluids and electrolytes due to hypovolemia and burns
Administer medications
Refer to the relevant training level for specific indications within a protocol

contentEn.heading: IV Procedure
points: 1. Maintain aseptic techniques throughout the procedure
2. Gather and prepare equipment: select and inspect the catheter device; select and inspect the IV solution and administration set; prime the IV tubing
3. Choose and prepare an appropriate site
4. Initiate the IV
5. Connect IV tubing and infuse solution
6. Calculate and maintain an appropriate flow rate
7. Secure the IV

contentEn.heading: IV Maintenance
points: Ensure that the appropriate solution is running
Calculate and maintain the appropriate flow rate
Monitor flow rate and amount of solution

Reassess patient condition and IV on a regular basis (q 5-15 min): reassess ABCs and injury sites; reassess vital signs; inspect the IV site, tubing, and solution bag; observe for complications and take appropriate measures; maintain an appropriate flow rate; change the solution bag if required

contentEn.heading: Rate Calculation
points: Maintenance rate is approximately 75 mL/hr
Two common administration sets: 10 gtts/mL (macro-drip) and 60 gtts/mL (micro-drip)
Formula: gtts per minute = (volume to be infused x set rate) / time in minutes
Example 1: 500 mL NS over 12 hours with a macro-drip set (10 gtts/mL) = 5000 / 720 = 7 gtts/min
Example 2: 25 mL D10W in 60 minutes with a micro-drip set (60 gtts/mL) = 1500 / 60 = 25 gtts/min

contentZh.heading: 适应症
points: 补充因 hypovolemia（低血容量）和烧伤丢失的液体与电解质
给药途径
具体协议内的指征请参照相应培训级别的规定

contentZh.heading: IV 操作步骤
points: 1. 全程保持无菌技术（aseptic technique）
2. 准备器材：选择并检查留置针（catheter device）；选择并检查输液液体和输液器（administration set）；对输液管排气（prime the tubing）
3. 选择并准备合适的穿刺部位
4. 建立静脉通路
5. 连接输液管并开始输液
6. 计算并维持合适的滴速
7. 固定 IV

contentZh.heading: IV 维护
points: 确认输的是正确的液体
计算并维持正确的滴速
监测滴速和已输液量
定期（每 5-15 分钟）重新评估患者和 IV：复查 ABC 和损伤部位；复查生命体征；检查穿刺点、输液管和液体袋；观察并处理并发症；维持滴速；必要时更换液体袋

contentZh.heading: 滴速计算
points: 维持速度（maintenance rate）约为 75 mL/hr
两种常用输液器：10 gtts/mL（macro-drip 大滴）和 60 gtts/mL（micro-drip 微滴）
公式：每分钟滴数 gtts/min =（输液量 × 输液器滴系数）÷ 时间（分钟）
例 1：用 macro-drip（10 gtts/mL）在 12 小时内输 500 mL NS = 5000 ÷ 720 = 7 gtts/min
例 2：用 micro-drip（60 gtts/mL）在 60 分钟内输 25 mL D10W = 1500 ÷ 60 = 25 gtts/min

examTipsEn: Memorize the formula: gtts/min = (volume x drip set rate) / time in minutes - calculation questions are common.
Maintenance rate is approximately 75 mL/hr.
Reassess the patient and the IV every 5-15 minutes: site, tubing, bag, flow rate, complications.
examTipsZh: 背熟公式：gtts/min =（输液量 × 滴系数）÷ 分钟数——计算题必考。
维持速度约 75 mL/hr。
每 5-15 分钟重评患者和 IV：穿刺点、管路、液袋、滴速、并发症。

contentEn.heading: Indications and Contraindications
points: Indication: patient in cardiac arrest
Contraindication: verifiable Do Not Resuscitate (DNR) or No CPR orders

contentEn.heading: Algorithm
points: Determine the patient is in cardiac arrest: assess breathing and check pulse simultaneously, no more than 10 seconds
No pulse or breathing, or gasping breathing: begin CPR
Perform CPR 30:2
Position the AED and analyze as soon as possible
If shock advised: defibrillate, 2 minutes of CPR, analyze, repeat
If no shock advised: start 2 minutes of CPR, analyze, repeat

contentEn.heading: Adult Basics
points: Immediately activate the emergency response system (if appropriate) and get an AED (if available)
Optimum chest compression rate is 100-120 per minute with a depth of 5.0 to 6.0 cm in a normal adult (adjust to 1/3 to 1/2 the chest diameter for smaller and bigger patients)
Ratio is 30:2 (one or two rescuers)
Single shocks - resume CPR immediately following delivery of a shock, and during the charging phase
No Shock Advised - resume CPR immediately

contentEn.heading: Continue CPR/AED Until
points: Care is transferred over to more advanced providers
There are signs of life (patient movement, coughing, breathing)
30 minutes have elapsed with no ROSC and no defibrillations
Or 40 minutes if you had ROSC at any time or defibrillations

contentZh.heading: 适应症与禁忌症
points: 适应症：心脏骤停（cardiac arrest）的患者
禁忌症：可核实的 Do Not Resuscitate（DNR）或 No CPR 指令

contentZh.heading: 流程
points: 确定心脏骤停：同时评估呼吸和脉搏，不超过 10 秒
无脉搏、无呼吸或濒死叹息样呼吸（gasping）：开始 CPR
按 30:2 进行 CPR
尽快贴 AED 并分析心律
建议电击（shock advised）：除颤 → 2 分钟 CPR → 分析 → 重复
不建议电击（no shock advised）：先做 2 分钟 CPR → 分析 → 重复

contentZh.heading: 成人要点
points: 立即启动应急反应系统（如适用）并取得 AED（如有）
最佳按压频率 100-120 次/分钟，正常成人深度 5.0-6.0 cm（体型偏小或偏大者调整为胸廓前后径的 1/3 至 1/2）
按压通气比 30:2（单人或双人相同）
单次电击后立即恢复 CPR，充电期间也持续按压
「不建议电击」时也立即恢复 CPR

contentZh.heading: 持续 CPR/AED 直到
points: 把患者交接给更高级的救护人员
出现生命迹象（患者活动、咳嗽、呼吸）
已进行 30 分钟且从未出现 ROSC、从未除颤
如果任何时候出现过 ROSC 或做过除颤，则延长到 40 分钟

examTipsEn: The termination rule: 30 minutes with no ROSC and no shocks, extended to 40 minutes if there was ever ROSC or any defibrillation.
Breathing and pulse are assessed SIMULTANEOUSLY in no more than 10 seconds; gasping counts as arrest.
Rate 100-120/min, depth 5-6 cm, ratio 30:2 regardless of one or two rescuers.
examTipsZh: 终止规则：30 分钟内无 ROSC 且从未除颤可终止；只要出现过 ROSC 或除过颤，延长到 40 分钟。
呼吸和脉搏要同时评估、不超过 10 秒；gasping（叹息样呼吸）按骤停处理。
频率 100-120/分、深度 5-6 cm、比例 30:2（单双人都一样）。

contentEn.heading: Algorithm
points: Determine the patient is in cardiac arrest: assess breathing and check pulse simultaneously, no more than 10 seconds
No pulse, or pulse < 60 with inadequate perfusion: begin CPR
Perform CPR - Neonate 3:1; 1 rescuer 30:2; 2 rescuers 15:2
Position the AED and analyze as soon as possible
If shock advised: defibrillate, 2 minutes CPR, analyze, repeat; if no shock advised: 2 minutes CPR, analyze, repeat
Continue until care is transferred to more advanced providers or there are signs of life (patient movement, coughing, breathing)

contentEn.heading: Infant/Child Basics
points: Due to the size of an infant's head in relation to its body, use a pad (if available) under the shoulders to facilitate neutral position
Effective ventilation/oxygenation is very important for optimal CPR
Assess for pulse using the brachial rather than the carotid artery

If alone, immediately start CPR for 5 cycles (about 2 minutes) before activating the emergency response system and applying the AED (for a witnessed collapse - alone or not - immediately activate the emergency response system and get an AED)

Start CPR if there is no pulse or if the heart rate is less than 60 beats per minute with signs of poor perfusion (e.g., pale skin or severe mottling, cyanosis, decreased or falling LOC, toxic appearance, often with a history of respiratory illness or sepsis)
Optimum compression rate is 100-120 per minute with a depth of 1/3 to 1/2 the chest diameter
The ratio is 30:2 for one rescuer and 15:2 for two rescuers

contentEn.heading: AED Pads
points: For a child 0-8 years of age, switch to child AED pads (if available). If not available, you may use the adult pads and deliver the adult joules
If the pads, when placed in the normal anterior/lateral position, are within 2.5 cm (one inch) of each other, shift to an anterior/posterior configuration
Single shocks - resume CPR immediately after a shock and during charging; No Shock Advised - resume CPR immediately

contentZh.heading: 流程
points: 确定心脏骤停：同时评估呼吸和脉搏，不超过 10 秒
无脉搏，或脉搏 < 60 次/分且灌注不足（inadequate perfusion）：开始 CPR
按压通气比——新生儿（Neonate）3:1；单人 30:2；双人 15:2
尽快贴 AED 并分析
建议电击：除颤 → 2 分钟 CPR → 分析 → 重复；不建议电击：2 分钟 CPR → 分析 → 重复
持续到交接给更高级救护人员或出现生命迹象（活动、咳嗽、呼吸）

contentZh.heading: 婴儿/儿童要点
points: 婴儿头部相对身体比例大，可在肩下垫垫子（如有）以保持中立位
有效的通气/氧合对儿科 CPR 尤其重要
评估脉搏用肱动脉（brachial artery），不用颈动脉
单人在场时，先做 5 个循环（约 2 分钟）CPR，再启动应急反应系统和贴 AED（目击倒下时——无论是否单人——立即启动系统并取 AED）
无脉搏，或心率 < 60 次/分伴灌注不良体征（皮肤苍白或严重花斑、发绀、意识下降、中毒样面容，常有呼吸道疾病或 sepsis 病史）时开始 CPR
按压频率 100-120 次/分，深度为胸廓前后径的 1/3 至 1/2
按压通气比：单人 30:2，双人 15:2

contentZh.heading: AED 电极片
points: 0-8 岁儿童换用儿童电极片（如有）；没有儿童片时可以用成人片并给成人能量（adult joules）
如果按常规前-侧位（anterior/lateral）贴片时两片间距小于 2.5 cm（1 英寸），改为前-后位（anterior/posterior）
单次电击后立即恢复 CPR（充电期间也按压）；「不建议电击」也立即恢复 CPR

examTipsEn: Pediatric trigger to start CPR: no pulse OR heart rate < 60/min with poor perfusion.
Ratios: neonate 3:1, one rescuer 30:2, two rescuers 15:2; pulse check at the brachial artery.
Alone with an unwitnessed collapse: 5 cycles (~2 min) of CPR FIRST, then activate EMS/AED; witnessed collapse: activate immediately.
examTipsZh: 儿科启动 CPR 的标准：无脉搏，或心率 < 60/分伴灌注不良。
比例：新生儿 3:1、单人 30:2、双人 15:2；脉搏摸肱动脉。
单人+未目击倒下：先做 5 个循环（约 2 分钟）CPR 再呼救/贴 AED；目击倒下则立即呼救取 AED。

contentEn.heading: Core Principles
points: Early CPR is an essential component to successful outcome from cardiac arrest
CPR should be provided with as few interruptions as possible (keep interruptions to less than 5 seconds)
Change operators every 2 minutes (where possible) to maintain maximum efficiency
Pulse checks during analyze, but must be done with ROSC (e.g., spontaneous breaths, cough, eyelid movement, vocalization)
Early defibrillation is essential for arrhythmias responsive to defibrillation; early CPR and early defibrillation should coexist, and one should not impede the other
Complete recoil after each compression
Avoid hyperventilation
Once high-quality cardiac arrest management is initiated, an SGA can be inserted, for PCPs

contentEn.heading: Moving the Patient
points: CPR is more effective while you are stationary - trying to move the patient while performing CPR results in a deterioration of effective CPR
Intra-arrest patient transport with ongoing CPR may occur for: paediatrics, hypothermic, traumatic, or treatable causes
Move a patient early in your management while performing CPR only if the patient is in a dangerous environment or if you cannot perform CPR effectively because of the patient's position or location

contentEn.heading: Medical Oversight
points: Consult with medical oversight during a cardiac arrest to discontinue the arrest at the scene

contentZh.heading: 核心原则
points: 早期 CPR 是心脏骤停抢救成功的关键环节
尽量减少 CPR 中断（每次中断少于 5 秒）
尽可能每 2 分钟换人按压，保持最大效率
脉搏检查在 AED 分析期间进行，但必须结合 ROSC 迹象（如自主呼吸、咳嗽、眼睑活动、发声）
对除颤有反应的心律，早期除颤至关重要；早期 CPR 与早期除颤应并行，互不妨碍
每次按压后让胸廓完全回弹（complete recoil）
避免过度通气（hyperventilation）
高质量骤停管理建立后，PCP 可置入 SGA（声门上气道）

contentZh.heading: 搬动患者
points: 静止状态下的 CPR 更有效——边搬动边按压会让 CPR 质量恶化
以下情况可以边 CPR 边转运（intra-arrest transport）：儿科、低体温、创伤性骤停、存在可逆转病因（treatable causes）
只有在患者处于危险环境，或因体位/位置无法有效实施 CPR 时，才在管理早期搬动患者

contentZh.heading: 医疗指导
points: 需要在现场终止复苏（discontinue the arrest at the scene）时，必须联系 medical oversight（医疗指导）

examTipsEn: Interruptions to compressions must be under 5 seconds; switch compressors every 2 minutes.
Intra-arrest transport is reserved for: paediatric, hypothermic, traumatic arrests, or treatable causes.
Terminating resuscitation on scene requires consultation with medical oversight.
examTipsZh: 按压中断必须少于 5 秒；每 2 分钟换人。
边 CPR 边转运只适用于：儿科、低体温、创伤性骤停或存在可逆病因。
现场终止复苏必须先联系 medical oversight。

treatments.titleEn: Child Sudden Cardiac Arrest, Neonate and Newborn
treatments.titleZh: 儿童心源性猝死、新生儿复苏

contentEn.heading: Child (1 Year to Puberty) Sudden Cardiac Arrest
points: Most cardiac arrests in children are NOT due to sudden rhythm disturbances

On rare occasions a child is in ventricular fibrillation - specifically cases with a history of previous cardiac problems, electrocution, or a sharp blow to the precordial area followed by collapse (commotio cordis)

contentEn.heading: Neonate (Up to 28 Days)
points: 3:1 compression ratio
No AED

contentEn.heading: Newborn (Floppy, Limp, Not Breathing or Heart Rate < 100 bpm)
points: 1. Dry, stimulate, keep warm for 30 seconds - if heart rate < 100 bpm move to step 2
2. Ventilate with BVM on room air for 30 seconds - if heart rate < 100 bpm move to step 3
3. Ventilate with BVM with 100% oxygen attached for 30 seconds - if heart rate < 100 bpm move to step 4
4. Chest compressions with ventilations and 100% oxygen until heart rate is above 60 bpm

contentEn.heading: Asphyxia Arrest
points: Asphyxia arrest is due to hypoxia; causes may include overdose, hanging, airway obstruction, smoke inhalation and drowning
If alone with an AED, give 5 cycles of CPR (about 2 minutes) before applying the AED
If two rescuers: apply the AED while providing one-person CPR for 5 cycles (about 2 minutes), then analyze

contentZh.heading: 儿童（1 岁至青春期）心源性猝死
points: 儿童心脏骤停大多数不是由突发心律失常引起的
少数情况下儿童会出现室颤（ventricular fibrillation）——特别是有心脏病史、电击伤，或心前区受到猛烈撞击后倒下（commotio cordis 心震荡）的情况

contentZh.heading: 新生儿 Neonate（出生 28 天以内）
points: 按压通气比 3:1
不使用 AED

contentZh.heading: 刚出生的新生儿 Newborn（松软、无力、不呼吸或心率 < 100 次/分）
points: 1. 擦干、刺激、保暖 30 秒——心率仍 < 100 进入第 2 步
2. BVM 室内空气通气 30 秒——心率仍 < 100 进入第 3 步
3. BVM 接 100% 氧气通气 30 秒——心率仍 < 100 进入第 4 步
4. 胸外按压 + 通气 + 100% 氧气，直到心率超过 60 次/分

contentZh.heading: 窒息性骤停 Asphyxia Arrest
points: 窒息性骤停由缺氧（hypoxia）导致；原因包括药物过量、缢吊、气道梗阻、烟雾吸入和溺水
单人且有 AED：先做 5 个循环（约 2 分钟）CPR，再贴 AED
双人：一人做 5 个循环 CPR 的同时另一人贴 AED，然后分析

examTipsEn: Newborn resuscitation is a 30-second ladder: dry/stimulate/warm - BVM room air - BVM 100% O2 - compressions, each step triggered by HR < 100 (compressions continue until HR > 60).
Neonate: 3:1 ratio and NO AED.
Asphyxial arrest (overdose, hanging, drowning, etc.): 5 cycles of CPR (~2 min) come before AED analysis when alone.
examTipsZh: 新生儿复苏是 30 秒一级的阶梯：擦干刺激保暖 → BVM 空气 → BVM 100% 氧 → 按压，每级以心率 < 100 为进入条件（按压做到心率 > 60）。
Neonate：比例 3:1，不用 AED。
窒息性骤停（过量、缢吊、溺水等）：单人时先做 5 个循环 CPR 再上 AED 分析。

treatments.titleEn: Treatable Causes of Cardiac Arrest and Transporting
treatments.titleZh: 心脏骤停的可逆病因与转运

contentEn.heading: Principles
points: CPR should continue until ROSC is achieved, further efforts are deemed futile, or the rescuers can no longer continue resuscitation due to fatigue or scene hazard
The decision to transport is multi-factorial and relies on available history and physical examination to give clues about reversible causes
If there is an apparent reversible cause, then transport can be considered

contentEn.heading: Reversible Causes (H's and T's)
points: Hypovolemia
Hypoxia
Hydrogen ion (acidosis)
Hypo/Hyperkalemia
Hypothermia
Tension pneumothorax
Tamponade, cardiac
Toxins (including anaphylaxis)
Thrombosis, pulmonary
Thrombosis, coronary

contentEn.heading: Suctioning
points: Suction should be applied for 10-15 seconds in the adult
10 seconds in the paediatric patient
5 seconds in an infant

contentZh.heading: 原则
points: CPR 应持续到出现 ROSC、判定继续无意义（futile），或救援者因疲劳或现场危险无法继续为止
是否转运是多因素决策，依靠现有病史和体格检查寻找可逆病因的线索
如果存在明显的可逆病因，可以考虑转运

contentZh.heading: 可逆病因（H's and T's）
points: Hypovolemia（低血容量）
Hypoxia（缺氧）
Hydrogen ion（酸中毒）
Hypo/Hyperkalemia（低钾/高钾血症）
Hypothermia（低体温）
Tension pneumothorax（张力性气胸）
Cardiac tamponade（心包填塞）
Toxins（毒素，包括 anaphylaxis）
Pulmonary thrombosis（肺栓塞）
Coronary thrombosis（冠状动脉血栓）

contentZh.heading: 吸引 Suctioning
points: 成人每次吸引 10-15 秒
儿童每次 10 秒
婴儿每次 5 秒

examTipsEn: Memorize the 5 H's and 5 T's - note that toxins INCLUDE anaphylaxis in this list.
Suction times: adult 10-15 s, paediatric 10 s, infant 5 s.
Transport during arrest is considered when a reversible cause is apparent.
examTipsZh: 背熟 5H 和 5T——注意 Toxins 里包括 anaphylaxis。
吸引时间：成人 10-15 秒、儿童 10 秒、婴儿 5 秒。
只有当存在明显可逆病因时，才考虑骤停中转运。

contentEn.heading: General Approach
points: Stabilize head and neck, if necessary
Assess level of consciousness (AVPU scale)
Assess and manage ABCs as required
Suction, AED and BVM

contentEn.heading: Unwitnessed Unconscious FBAO (Respirations Absent)
points: Attempt one ventilation; if no air entry or air blows back, reposition the head and attempt ventilation again; if still no air entry, begin chest compressions
Continue cycles of 30 compressions to 2 ventilations, inspecting for an object in the mouth prior to ventilating
If a foreign body is seen in the mouth, remove it

contentEn.heading: Witnessed Conscious to Unconscious FBAO
points: Partial obstruction: have the patient cough forcefully

Full obstruction: chest thrusts, back slaps, and abdominal thrusts are feasible and effective in conscious adults and children > 1 year of age; alternating between two techniques in sets of five is acceptable
For an infant: deliver repeated cycles of 5 back blows followed by 5 chest compressions until the object is expelled
If abdominal thrusts are not effective, consider chest thrusts
If the patient collapses: start CPR with chest compressions (do NOT perform a pulse check)
After 30 compressions, open the airway and visualize; do NOT perform blind finger sweeps
Attempt to give 2 breaths and continue with cycles of chest compressions, checking the airway; if a foreign body is seen in the mouth, remove it
Complete RBS and transport

contentZh.heading: 总体处理
points: 必要时固定头颈部
用 AVPU 量表评估意识水平
按需要评估并管理 ABC
准备好 suction、AED 和 BVM

contentZh.heading: 未目击的昏迷 FBAO（呼吸消失）
points: 尝试一次通气；如果无气体进入或气体反吹回来，重新摆放头位再试一次；仍无气体进入则开始胸外按压
以 30 按压：2 通气循环进行，每次通气前检查口腔内有无异物
看到口腔内异物就取出

contentZh.heading: 目击的由清醒转昏迷 FBAO
points: 部分梗阻：让患者用力咳嗽
完全梗阻：对清醒的成人和 1 岁以上儿童，胸部冲击（chest thrusts）、背部拍击（back slaps）和腹部冲击（abdominal thrusts）都可行有效；两种手法每 5 次交替使用是可以接受的
婴儿：反复进行「5 次背部拍击 + 5 次胸部按压」循环，直到异物排出
腹部冲击无效时，考虑胸部冲击
患者倒下昏迷：直接从胸外按压开始 CPR（不做脉搏检查）
每 30 次按压后开放气道并目视检查；禁止盲目手指清扫（blind finger sweep）
尝试给 2 次通气，继续按压循环并检查气道；看到异物就取出
完成 RBS 后转运

examTipsEn: When an FBAO patient collapses: start CPR with compressions and do NOT check for a pulse.
Never do blind finger sweeps - only remove an object you can SEE.
Infant sequence is 5 back blows + 5 chest compressions (no abdominal thrusts for infants).
examTipsZh: FBAO 患者倒下昏迷时：直接按压开始 CPR，不做脉搏检查。
禁止盲扫口腔——只有看得见的异物才能取。
婴儿手法是 5 次背部拍击 + 5 次胸部按压（婴儿不做腹部冲击）。

contentEn.heading: Indications
points: Patients whose presentation is suggestive of cardiac chest pain

contentEn.heading: Interventions For All Licence Levels
points: Place the patient in a position of comfort as permitted by clinical condition; in general, limit patient movement
Complete a primary survey and apply oxygen as required to maintain SpO2 >= 94%
Administer Acetylsalicylic acid, chewed and swallowed, if not already done prior to EHS arrival
Initiate transport (transport immediately if able; delegate crew members to prep egress if not)
Obtain a history (including pain assessment) and a baseline set of vital signs
Administer Nitroglycerin if appropriate (transport after the first dose if not already done)

contentEn.heading: Additional Primary Care Paramedic Interventions
points: Obtain vascular access with running intravenous fluid
Consider Dimenhydrinate for nausea

contentEn.heading: Pain Relieved / Persistent Pain
points: If pain is completely relieved but returns: re-initiate Nitroglycerin administration; continue with assessment, treatment, and vital signs q 5 minutes
If pain is completely relieved for more than 5 minutes, you may re-initiate the Nitroglycerin component (but NOT the Aspirin component) if the pain returns

If pain persists beyond 3 doses of Nitroglycerin, or if the SBP falls below 110 mmHg: administer Entonox 5 minutes after the last dose of Nitroglycerin; continue with assessment, treatment, and vitals q 5 minutes
After 30 minutes from the first dose of Nitroglycerin, this protocol may be repeated after stopping Nitrous Oxide for 5 minutes

contentZh.heading: 适应症
points: 临床表现提示心源性胸痛（cardiac chest pain）的患者

contentZh.heading: 所有执照级别的处置
points: 在病情允许的范围内取舒适体位；总体上限制患者活动
完成 primary survey，按需给氧维持 SpO2 ≥ 94%
给予 Acetylsalicylic acid（ASA/阿司匹林），嚼碎后吞服（如果 EHS 到达前尚未服用）
启动转运（能走就立即转运；不能就指派队员准备撤离通道 prep egress）
采集病史（含疼痛评估 pain assessment）和基线生命体征
适当时给予 Nitroglycerin（硝酸甘油）（如尚未转运，第一剂后开始转运）

contentZh.heading: PCP 附加处置
points: 建立血管通路并保持液体持续输注（running IV fluid）
恶心时考虑 Dimenhydrinate

contentZh.heading: 疼痛缓解/持续的处理
points: 疼痛完全缓解后又复发：重新开始 Nitroglycerin，并每 5 分钟评估、治疗和测生命体征
疼痛完全缓解超过 5 分钟后复发，可以重启 Nitroglycerin 部分，但不能重复 Aspirin 部分
疼痛在 3 剂 Nitroglycerin 后仍持续，或收缩压降到 110 mmHg 以下：在最后一剂 Nitroglycerin 5 分钟后给 Entonox，并每 5 分钟评估、治疗和测生命体征
距第一剂 Nitroglycerin 30 分钟后，停用 Nitrous Oxide 5 分钟即可重复本协议

examTipsEn: ASA is chewed and swallowed, and is given ONCE - never repeat the ASA component even if pain returns.
Switch to Entonox when pain persists beyond 3 nitro doses OR SBP falls below 110 mmHg, and wait 5 minutes after the last nitro.
Baseline vitals (including pain assessment) must be done before initiating the protocol - missing them is a 100% deduction.
examTipsZh: ASA 嚼碎吞服、只给一次——疼痛复发也绝不重复 ASA。
转 Entonox 的条件：3 剂 nitro 后仍痛，或 SBP 跌破 110 mmHg；而且要在最后一剂 nitro 后等 5 分钟。
启动协议前必须完成基线生命体征（含疼痛评估）——漏掉直接扣 100%。

contentEn.heading: Indications
points: Patients experiencing the sensation of nausea or vomiting

contentEn.heading: Interventions For All Licence Levels
points: Keep the patient at rest in a position of comfort
Maintain the patient in a position of comfort consistent with the need to protect the patient's airway

contentEn.heading: Additional Primary Care Paramedic Interventions
points: Consider vascular access
Consider dimenhydrinate
Consider ondansetron
Treat hypotension from volume loss - fluid bolus: 20 ml/kg to a maximum of 2 litres, reassessing every 500 ml
Reassess after every bolus; target systolic blood pressure of 90 mmHg

contentEn.heading: Notes
points: Stable patients may be treated with anti-emetics on scene; unstable patients will be treated en route to hospital
Continue to manage and be aware of possible vomiting; position the patient appropriately and have suction ready

contentZh.heading: 适应症
points: 出现恶心感或呕吐的患者

contentZh.heading: 所有执照级别的处置
points: 让患者在舒适体位下休息
在保护气道的前提下维持舒适体位

contentZh.heading: PCP 附加处置
points: 考虑建立血管通路
考虑 dimenhydrinate
考虑 ondansetron
治疗容量丢失引起的低血压——补液 bolus：20 ml/kg，最多 2 升，每 500 ml 重新评估
每次 bolus 后重新评估；目标收缩压 90 mmHg

contentZh.heading: 要点
points: 稳定患者可以在现场使用止吐药（anti-emetics）；不稳定患者在送医途中治疗
持续防范呕吐：摆好体位并把 suction 准备在手边

examTipsEn: Stable = anti-emetics on scene; unstable = treat en route.
Fluid target for hypotension from volume loss: SBP 90 mmHg, boluses of 20 ml/kg up to 2 L with reassessment every 500 ml.
Airway first: position the patient and keep suction ready at all times.
examTipsZh: 稳定患者现场给止吐药；不稳定患者途中处理。
容量丢失低血压的补液目标：SBP 90 mmHg；20 ml/kg、上限 2 L、每 500 ml 重评。
气道优先：体位摆好、suction 随时备用。

treatments.titleEn: Shortness of Breath With History of Asthma/COPD
treatments.titleZh: 呼吸困难（哮喘/COPD 病史）

contentEn.heading: Interventions For All Licence Levels
points: Place the patient in a position of comfort as permitted by clinical condition; in general this will be a seated position with the patient leaning forward; limit patient movement
Complete a primary survey and provide supplemental oxygen as required to maintain SpO2 >= 94% (caution: may not be achievable)
Auscultation
Initiate transport (transport immediately if able; delegate crew members to prep egress if not)
Obtain a history and a baseline set of vital signs
Salbutamol by nebulizer or MDI (transport after the first dose if not already done)
MDI and spacer use is strongly recommended for patients with signs of influenza-like illness or other infectious respiratory conditions
If the patient is ventilated, administer MDI via the side port on the BVM

contentEn.heading: Additional Primary Care Paramedic Interventions
points: Salbutamol with ipratropium (both can be combined in the same nebulizer for co-administration; ipratropium is a single dose administration, while salbutamol may be repeated)
For severe disease or imminent respiratory failure: administer intramuscular Epinephrine
Epinephrine IM should be considered for a patient with SpO2 < 90% and/or moderate to severe symptoms of bronchospasm unresolved with Salbutamol by MDI or nebulizer
Consider dexamethasone
Consider CPAP

contentEn.heading: Oxygen Administration Principles
points: Do not use an adult face mask with a flow rate of less than 6 L/min - this would deliver less oxygen than room air
A non-rebreather mask is indicated for carbon monoxide poisoning and smoke inhalation

Administration of oxygen to COPD patients is by nasal cannula at 1-3 L/min (following acute care treatment with high flow oxygen, if required); high flow oxygen IS indicated for COPD patients complaining of SOB
Titrate oxygen based on pulse oximetry aiming for 94% if the patient is not SOB or in shock; patients who are SOB, in shock, or have CO poisoning require high flow O2

Escalation: titrate O2 to max 15 L/min for SpO2 94% - switch to non-rebreather at 15 L/min - add nasal cannula at 15 L/min underneath - consider CPAP (PCP) - consider assisted ventilations (including PEEP for PCPs) - record SpO2 changes through treatment

contentZh.heading: 所有执照级别的处置
points: 在病情允许下取舒适体位——通常是坐位、身体前倾（leaning forward）；限制患者活动
完成 primary survey，按需给氧维持 SpO2 ≥ 94%（注意：可能达不到）
听诊（auscultation）
启动转运（能走就立即转运；否则指派队员准备撤离通道）
采集病史和基线生命体征
Salbutamol 雾化（nebulizer）或 MDI 给药（如尚未转运，第一剂后开始转运）
对有流感样症状或其他呼吸道感染表现的患者，强烈建议使用 MDI + spacer（储雾罐）
如患者正在被通气，经 BVM 侧孔（side port）给 MDI

contentZh.heading: PCP 附加处置
points: Salbutamol 联合 ipratropium（两药可以混在同一个雾化器里同时给；注意 ipratropium 只给一次，salbutamol 可以重复）
病情严重或即将呼吸衰竭：肌注 Epinephrine（IM）
SpO2 < 90% 和/或中重度支气管痉挛经 Salbutamol（MDI 或雾化）无效时，应考虑肌注 Epinephrine
考虑 dexamethasone
考虑 CPAP

contentZh.heading: 氧疗原则
points: 成人面罩流量不得低于 6 L/min——低于此流量给的氧比室内空气还少
一氧化碳中毒和烟雾吸入用非重复呼吸面罩（non-rebreather mask）
COPD 患者常规用鼻导管 1-3 L/min（如需要，先做高流量氧急性处理）；COPD 患者主诉 SOB 时高流量氧是有指征的
根据脉搏血氧滴定氧流量，目标 94%（不 SOB、不休克时）；SOB、休克或 CO 中毒患者需要高流量氧
升级路径：滴定至最大 15 L/min 达 SpO2 94% → 换非重复呼吸面罩 15 L/min → 面罩下加鼻导管 15 L/min → 考虑 CPAP（PCP）→ 考虑辅助通气（PCP 可加 PEEP）→ 记录治疗过程中 SpO2 的变化

examTipsEn: Ipratropium is a SINGLE dose; salbutamol may be repeated - they can be mixed in the same nebulizer (PCP).
IM Epinephrine (PCP) is for SpO2 < 90% and/or moderate-severe bronchospasm not resolving with salbutamol.
Never run an adult face mask below 6 L/min; NRB is the mask for CO poisoning and smoke inhalation.
examTipsZh: Ipratropium 只给一次，salbutamol 可重复——两药可混同一雾化器（PCP）。
PCP 肌注 Epinephrine 的条件：SpO2 < 90% 和/或 salbutamol 无效的中重度支气管痉挛。
成人面罩流量绝不低于 6 L/min；CO 中毒和烟雾吸入用 NRB 面罩。

contentEn.heading: Overview
points: CPAP is a non-invasive means to increase oxygen diffusion across the alveolar membrane by increasing functional residual capacity and alveolar surface area
It decreases work of breathing and oxygen consumption while increasing oxygen supply; CPAP has been shown to reduce intubation requirements and mortality
Consider CPAP in patients who remain short of breath with low oxygen saturation despite a bronchodilator, or with other causes of shortness of breath (CHF, pulmonary edema, near drowning, pneumonia)

Any patient unable to maintain their own respiratory effort is unlikely to benefit from CPAP - these patients require assisted ventilation via BVM (add a PEEP valve if no contraindications) and must be monitored closely for deterioration

contentEn.heading: Indications
points: Any patient >= 13 years of age in significant respiratory distress
Awake and following commands
Maintains a patent airway
Exhibits ALL of the following: RR > 24; SpO2 < 94% (on O2); accessory muscle use
Consider in adult respiratory distress including: congestive heart failure / acute cardiogenic pulmonary edema, asthma, submersion injuries, pneumonia, COPD

contentEn.heading: Contraindications
points: Patient 12 years and less
Decreased level of consciousness or inability to follow commands
Respiratory arrest or hypoventilation
Imminent or actual respiratory failure (slow respirations, shallow tidal volumes, falling LOC) - these patients must be ventilated with a BVM (may benefit from PEEP)
Unable to fit a mask to the patient's face
Vomiting or any other risk of aspiration
Traumatic cause of respiratory distress
Tracheostomy
Suspected or known pneumothorax
Systolic blood pressure < 90 mmHg

contentEn.heading: CPAP Use
points: 1. Start at 5 L/min with the CPAP valve at 5 cmH2O
2. Obtain a facial seal
3. Reassess patient and vitals
4. Repeat in 2.5 cmH2O increments to a maximum CPAP of 10 cmH2O
If the patient deteriorates: remove CPAP and use BVM with assisted ventilations (consider PEEP valve if indicated)
Settings table: CPAP 5 / 6 / 7.5 / 10 / 12.5 / 15 cmH2O pairs with oxygen flow 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 / 9 / 10 LPM

contentEn.heading: PEEP Use
points: 1. Attach the PEEP valve to the exhaust port on the bag-valve mask (BVM at 15 lpm)
2. Set the dial on the PEEP valve to 5 cmH2O
3. Establish and maintain a good mask seal; ventilate at an appropriate rate, usually no more than 8-10 breaths per minute
4. Monitor oxygen saturation and blood pressure for changes
5. PEEP may be increased in increments of 2.5 cmH2O to a maximum of 10 cmH2O
If the patient becomes hypotensive (< 90 systolic) or goes into cardiac arrest: remove the PEEP valve

contentZh.heading: 概述
points: CPAP 是一种无创手段，通过增加功能残气量（functional residual capacity）和肺泡表面积来提高氧气跨肺泡膜的弥散
它能降低呼吸做功和耗氧量、增加供氧；已证实 CPAP 可减少插管需求并降低死亡率
在使用支气管扩张剂后仍然呼吸困难、血氧低的患者，或其他原因（CHF、肺水肿、近溺水、肺炎）导致呼吸困难的患者，应考虑 CPAP
无法维持自主呼吸努力的患者用 CPAP 无益——这类患者需要 BVM 辅助通气（无禁忌时加 PEEP 阀），并须密切监测病情恶化

contentZh.heading: 适应症
points: 年龄 ≥ 13 岁、显著呼吸窘迫的患者
清醒且能遵从指令（awake and following commands）
能维持气道通畅
同时满足以下全部三条：呼吸频率 RR > 24；吸氧状态下 SpO2 < 94%；使用辅助呼吸肌（accessory muscle use）
可考虑用于成人呼吸窘迫，包括：CHF/急性心源性肺水肿、哮喘、淹溺伤（submersion injuries）、肺炎、COPD

contentZh.heading: 禁忌症
points: 12 岁及以下患者
意识水平下降或无法遵从指令
呼吸停止或通气不足（hypoventilation）
即将或已经呼吸衰竭（呼吸慢、潮气量浅、意识持续下降）——这类患者必须 BVM 通气（可加 PEEP）
面罩无法与患者面部贴合
呕吐或任何误吸风险
创伤性原因导致的呼吸窘迫
气管切开（tracheostomy）
疑似或确诊气胸（pneumothorax）
收缩压 < 90 mmHg

contentZh.heading: CPAP 使用步骤
points: 1. 从氧流量 5 L/min、CPAP 阀 5 cmH2O 开始
2. 获得面部密封（facial seal）
3. 重新评估患者和生命体征
4. 以 2.5 cmH2O 为增量上调，CPAP 最大 10 cmH2O
患者恶化时：撤除 CPAP，改用 BVM 辅助通气（有指征时考虑 PEEP 阀）
参数对照表：CPAP 5 / 6 / 7.5 / 10 / 12.5 / 15 cmH2O 分别对应氧流量 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 / 9 / 10 LPM

contentZh.heading: PEEP 使用步骤
points: 1. 把 PEEP 阀装到 BVM 的呼气口（exhaust port）上（BVM 氧流量 15 lpm）
2. PEEP 阀刻度调到 5 cmH2O
3. 建立并保持良好的面罩密封；以合适的频率通气，通常不超过 8-10 次/分钟
4. 监测血氧饱和度和血压的变化
5. PEEP 可以按 2.5 cmH2O 增量上调，最大 10 cmH2O
患者出现低血压（收缩压 < 90）或心脏骤停时：撤除 PEEP 阀

examTipsEn: CPAP indications require ALL THREE: RR > 24, SpO2 < 94% on O2, accessory muscle use - plus age >= 13, awake, following commands, patent airway.
Both CPAP and PEEP start at 5 cmH2O and titrate by 2.5 cmH2O to a max of 10 cmH2O.
SBP < 90 is a contraindication for CPAP and the trigger to REMOVE a PEEP valve.
examTipsZh: CPAP 适应症三条必须同时满足：RR > 24、吸氧下 SpO2 < 94%、辅助呼吸肌使用——外加年龄 ≥ 13、清醒遵嘱、气道通畅。
CPAP 和 PEEP 都从 5 cmH2O 起始、按 2.5 递增、上限 10 cmH2O。
SBP < 90 既是 CPAP 的禁忌，也是撤除 PEEP 阀的信号。

contentEn.heading: Indications
points: Patients with ALL of the following: hypovolemia; systolic BP < 90 mmHg; other clinical signs or symptoms of shock
Patients with burns > 20% BSA (partial and full thickness)
Obtain evidence of loss of a significant quantity of blood or body fluids to support a diagnosis of hypovolemia
The protocol may be used for patients with BP > 90 mmHg if shock is anticipated because of the mechanism of injury, the nature and extent of the injuries, or the patient's condition

contentEn.heading: Interventions For All Licence Levels
points: Control external hemorrhage
Splint pelvis/fractures, if clinically indicated
Position the patient supine to support blood pressure
Keep the patient warm and protect from further heat loss
Administer supplemental oxygen to maintain SpO2 >= 94%

contentEn.heading: Additional Primary Care Paramedic Interventions (En Route or Time Delay)
points: Obtain vascular access
Consider fluid bolus to correct hypoperfusion or hypotension if clinically indicated - 20 ml/kg to a maximum of 2 litres, reassessing every 500 ml
Consider tranexamic acid in cases of shock secondary to blood loss and hypovolemia secondary to occult bleeding

contentZh.heading: 适应症
points: 同时满足以下全部：低血容量（hypovolemia）；收缩压 < 90 mmHg；其他休克的临床症状或体征
烧伤面积 > 20% BSA（部分和全层厚度）的患者
应有大量血液或体液丢失的证据来支持 hypovolemia 的诊断
如果根据受伤机制、损伤性质与范围或患者状况预计将出现休克，血压 > 90 mmHg 的患者也可以使用本协议

contentZh.heading: 所有执照级别的处置
points: 控制外出血
有临床指征时夹板固定骨盆/骨折
让患者仰卧（supine）以支持血压
保暖并防止进一步热量流失
补充氧气维持 SpO2 ≥ 94%

contentZh.heading: PCP 附加处置（途中或转运延迟时）
points: 建立血管通路
有临床指征时考虑补液 bolus 纠正低灌注或低血压——20 ml/kg，最多 2 升，每 500 ml 重新评估
对失血性休克和隐匿性出血（occult bleeding）导致的低血容量，考虑 tranexamic acid（TXA）

examTipsEn: Indications need ALL of: hypovolemia + SBP < 90 + other signs of shock; burns > 20% BSA also qualify.
The protocol can be started with BP > 90 when shock is ANTICIPATED from mechanism or injuries.
PCP fluids: 20 ml/kg to max 2 L, reassess every 500 ml; TXA for shock from blood loss or occult bleeding.
examTipsZh: 适应症三条全要：hypovolemia + SBP < 90 + 其他休克体征；烧伤 > 20% BSA 也适用。
根据机制或伤情预计会休克时，BP > 90 也可以提前启动本协议。
PCP 补液：20 ml/kg、上限 2 L、每 500 ml 重评；失血性/隐匿出血休克考虑 TXA。

contentEn.heading: Indications
points: Patient with suspected anaphylaxis, including ALL of the following:
Signs of anaphylaxis: respiratory (SOB/wheezes/cough/stridor), abdominal (N/V/D/pain), hypotension (or decreased LOC), urticaria, and/or angioneurotic edema, and/or hypotension/shock
Exposure to an allergen
Unstable: syncope, decreased LOC, or hypotension (BP < 90 mmHg), or respiratory distress

contentEn.heading: Interventions For All Licence Levels
points: Position supine to improve blood pressure and do NOT walk the patient
Remove the allergen (e.g., scrape off any stinger(s) / stop drug administration)
Complete a primary survey and provide airway management and supplemental oxygen as required to maintain SpO2 >= 94%
Delegate crew members to prep egress
Obtain a history and a baseline set of vital signs
Administer Epinephrine
Transport and continue assessment / treatment en route

contentEn.heading: Additional Primary Care Paramedic Interventions
points: Obtain vascular access and fluid administration if the patient remains hypotensive or hypoperfused - fluid bolus: 20 ml/kg to a maximum of 2 litres, reassessing every 500 ml
Treat bronchospasm after epinephrine has been administered with Salbutamol
Administer Diphenhydramine to mitigate medium-term effects and limit the histamine response

contentZh.heading: 适应症
points: 疑似 anaphylaxis 的患者，须同时具备以下全部：
Anaphylaxis 的体征：呼吸系统（SOB/哮鸣音/咳嗽/喘鸣 stridor）、腹部（恶心/呕吐/腹泻/腹痛）、低血压（或意识下降）、荨麻疹（urticaria）和/或血管神经性水肿（angioneurotic edema）和/或低血压/休克
过敏原（allergen）暴露史
不稳定表现：晕厥（syncope）、意识下降、低血压（BP < 90 mmHg）或呼吸窘迫

contentZh.heading: 所有执照级别的处置
points: 让患者仰卧以改善血压，绝对不要让患者行走（do NOT walk the patient）
去除过敏原（例如刮除毒刺 stinger / 停止药物输注）
完成 primary survey，按需进行气道管理和补氧，维持 SpO2 ≥ 94%
指派队员准备撤离通道（prep egress）
采集病史和基线生命体征
给予 Epinephrine
转运，途中继续评估和治疗

contentZh.heading: PCP 附加处置
points: 如患者仍低血压或低灌注：建立血管通路并补液——bolus 20 ml/kg，最多 2 升，每 500 ml 重新评估
Epinephrine 给完之后，用 Salbutamol 治疗支气管痉挛
给 Diphenhydramine 以缓解中期效应、限制组胺反应（histamine response）

examTipsEn: Keep the patient SUPINE and never walk them - sudden standing can cause cardiovascular collapse.
Epinephrine comes first; salbutamol for bronchospasm only AFTER epinephrine (PCP).
Delay in epinephrine is a classic major deduction - do not hold it for IV or history completion.
examTipsZh: 患者必须仰卧、绝不让其行走——突然站立可导致心血管崩溃。
Epinephrine 永远第一；Salbutamol 只能在 epinephrine 之后处理支气管痉挛（PCP）。
延迟给 epinephrine 是经典大扣分——不要为了开 IV 或问病史而拖延。

contentEn.heading: Indications
points: Decreased level of consciousness and depressed respiratory drive, demonstrated by both decreased rate and limited tidal volume
Additional signs and symptoms of opioid overdose: pinpoint pupils (miosis), hypotension, hypothermia, tachycardia

contentEn.heading: Interventions For All Licence Levels
points: Complete a primary survey, ensuring that the airway is managed with positioning, suctioning, and adjunct insertion as needed
Ventilations are supported as required; consider the use of two-person BVM techniques
Oxygen is administered to maintain SpO2 >= 94%
Obtain a history and a baseline set of vital signs (including blood glucose level)
If blood glucose <= 4 mmol/L, correct the glucose level
Administer Naloxone
Transport and continue assessment / treatment / protocol en route

contentEn.heading: Additional Primary Care Paramedic Interventions
points: In cases of continued unconsciousness and apnea, consider establishing vascular access and giving naloxone intravenously

contentZh.heading: 适应症
points: 意识水平下降 + 呼吸驱动受抑制（呼吸频率下降且潮气量受限，两者都要有）
阿片类药物过量的其他症状体征：针尖样瞳孔（pinpoint pupils / miosis）、低血压、低体温、心动过速（tachycardia）

contentZh.heading: 所有执照级别的处置
points: 完成 primary survey，通过体位、吸引和气道辅助器（adjunct）按需管理气道
按需要支持通气；考虑双人 BVM 技术
给氧维持 SpO2 ≥ 94%
采集病史和基线生命体征（必须包含血糖 blood glucose）
如果血糖 ≤ 4 mmol/L，先纠正血糖
给予 Naloxone
转运，途中继续评估/治疗/执行协议

contentZh.heading: PCP 附加处置
points: 如果持续昏迷且呼吸暂停（apnea），考虑建立血管通路并静脉给 naloxone

examTipsEn: Ventilate FIRST - airway and breathing support come before naloxone.
Baseline vitals must include a blood glucose; correct BGL <= 4 mmol/L before assuming pure opioid toxicity.
Grading note: assessing only LOC to decide on Narcan is a deduction - assess respiratory rate and tidal volume too.
examTipsZh: 先通气——气道和呼吸支持在 naloxone 之前。
基线生命体征必须含血糖；血糖 ≤ 4 mmol/L 要先纠正，不能想当然全归咎于阿片。
评分要点：只看 LOC 就决定给 Narcan 会被扣分——必须同时评估呼吸频率和潮气量。

contentEn.heading: Indications
points: Known diabetic patients with decreased LOC whose history suggests hyperglycemia or hypoglycemia
Decreased LOC patients without a known cause

contentEn.heading: Interventions For All Licence Levels
points: Complete a primary survey, ensuring that the airway is managed with positioning, suctioning, and adjunct insertion as needed
Oxygen is administered to maintain SpO2 >= 94%
Position the patient in the lateral or 3/4 prone position if needed
Delegate crew members to prep egress
Obtain a history and a baseline set of vital signs (including blood glucose level)
Evaluate for stroke signs and symptoms
Correct suspected hypoglycemia (BGL < 4.0 mmol/L): for patients with sufficient mentation to maintain an airway, apply glucose gel to the oral mucosa

contentEn.heading: Emergency Medical Responder Interventions
points: For patients with insufficient mentation or an unprotected airway, administer glucagon
Transport and continue assessment / treatment en route

contentEn.heading: Additional Primary Care Paramedic Interventions
points: Obtain vascular access
Correct confirmed hypoglycemia: D10W 10-25 g (100-250 ml of 10% solution)
Glucagon if unable to obtain IV access
Transport and continue assessment / treatment en route (after the first bolus of D10 or the glucagon has been administered)

contentZh.heading: 适应症
points: 已知糖尿病患者意识下降，病史提示高血糖（hyperglycemia）或低血糖（hypoglycemia）
原因不明的意识下降患者

contentZh.heading: 所有执照级别的处置
points: 完成 primary survey，通过体位、吸引和气道辅助器按需管理气道
给氧维持 SpO2 ≥ 94%
必要时让患者取侧卧位（lateral）或 3/4 俯卧位（3/4 prone）
指派队员准备撤离通道
采集病史和基线生命体征（必须包含血糖）
评估卒中的症状和体征
纠正疑似低血糖（BGL < 4.0 mmol/L）：对意识足以保护气道（sufficient mentation）的患者，把 glucose gel 涂抹在口腔黏膜上

contentZh.heading: EMR 处置
points: 对意识不足或气道不受保护的患者，给 glucagon
转运，途中继续评估和治疗

contentZh.heading: PCP 附加处置
points: 建立血管通路
纠正确诊的低血糖：D10W 10-25 g（10% 溶液 100-250 ml）
无法建立 IV 时用 glucagon
转运并在途中继续评估/治疗（在第一剂 D10 bolus 或 glucagon 给完之后再出发）

examTipsEn: Glucose gel only if mentation is sufficient to protect the airway; otherwise EMR = glucagon, PCP = IV D10W (glucagon only if no IV).
Hypoglycemia threshold is BGL < 4.0 mmol/L; D10W dose is 10-25 g (100-250 ml of 10%).
Always evaluate for stroke signs - hypoglycemia and stroke can present identically.
examTipsZh: 只有意识足以保护气道才可以用 glucose gel；否则 EMR 用 glucagon，PCP 用 IV D10W（打不上 IV 才用 glucagon）。
低血糖阈值 BGL < 4.0 mmol/L；D10W 剂量 10-25 g（10% 溶液 100-250 ml）。
必须评估卒中体征——低血糖和卒中的表现可以一模一样。
